description:
Way of the Spore

You draw forth disease from your symbiotes and inflict it upon a creature you touch. Roll Spirit vs. Fortitude against the target. On a loss, the disease fails to take hold. On a win, record your roll result as this spell’s Difficulty, then choose one of the following diseases:

  • Blinding Sickness. The creature’s eyes swell shut; it becomes Blinded.

  • Fever. A raging fever wracks the creature. Its Strength rolls are Ill-Favored and its Defense is reduced by half your HEART score.

  • Seizure. The creature is overcome with violent shaking. It falls prone and automatically fails all Dexterity Skill Checks.

  • Flesh Rot. The creature’s flesh decays. Its Awe, Perform, Courtesy, and Persuade rolls are Ill-Favored.

  • Delusion. The creature’s mind clouds. Its Insight, Awareness, Lore, and Riddle rolls are Ill-Favored.

The disease lasts up to 7 days. At the end of each day, the affected creature rolls Fortitude against the spell’s Difficulty. On a success, the disease ends.

Whenever an infected creature touches another creature, that creature must roll Fortitude against the spell’s Difficulty. On a failure, it contracts the same disease.

Each time a creature successfully resists or ends the disease, reduce the spell’s Difficulty by 1.
name: Contagion
